message.content:
This document is a technical README/study for **Project Maya**, an inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) with experimental AMD HIP support. Key technical points:

## Models & Quantization
- **GLM-5.3-Flash** (320B total/18B active, 45 layers, 3:1 linear/sparse attention, mHC hyper-connections, 288 experts top-8): Maya quants named by tier (XS/S/M/L by expert bits)
